meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 接着 `migrate-v2.sh` 跑完后剩下的迁移工作:读 handoff.json 定位失败步骤、验证 v2 能收发消息、确认并授予 owner 角色、跑 `/migrate-memory` 迁移旧记忆、核对容器挂载配置,并判断 v1 的自定义代码哪些可移植。
howto.when: 在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 执行完成、它把控制权交回 Claude 之后接管;或当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”等关键词时触发。若 handoff.json 不存在,它会停下来让你先去终端跑脚本。

say.text: 读一下 handoff.json,告诉我哪些迁移步骤失败了
say.note: 会列出各步结果和 followups 待办清单

say.text: 帮我跑一下旧记忆迁移

howto.what_en: Does the remaining work after `migrate-v2.sh` finishes: reads handoff.json to find failed steps, proves v2 routes real messages, confirms and grants the owner role, runs `/migrate-memory` for legacy memory, checks container mount config, and judges which v1 fork customizations are portable.
howto.when_en: Takes over after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes and hands control back to Claude, or when you mention "migrate from v1", "finish migration", etc. If handoff.json is missing, it stops and asks you to run the script in your terminal first.

say_en.text: Read handoff.json and tell me which migration steps failed
say_en.note: Lists per-step results and the followups list

say_en.text: My user ID is telegram:6037840640, grant me the owner role
say_en.note: Inserts an owner row in user_roles

say_en.text: Run the legacy memory migration for me
